summary.text: Adrian Madaro is a Democratic state representative from the 1st Suffolk District who has served since April 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Revenue.

paragraphs.text: Adrian Madaro assumed office in the Massachusetts House on April 8, 2015.

For 2025-2026 he was chair of the Revenue Joint Committee, and he previously chaired the Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery Joint Committee, as its House chair in 2021-2022 and as chair in 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
